title: MenuMolder
description: A new way to move overlapping GUI to ensure a clean, good looking experience for all users!
body:
# MenuMolder 🎨  
Your HUD. Your rules. Your masterpiece.  
You've spent hours curating the perfect modpack. Hundreds of mods, thousands of features — and somehow, your screen has become a wall of overlapping HUD elements that looks like a toddler got hold of a UI toolkit. Health bars fighting for space with minimaps. Item durability widgets elbowing past quest trackers. It's chaos. Beautiful, mod-fuelled chaos.  
MenuMolder is here to restore order — on your terms.  
MenuMolder is a Fabric mod that hands the power of your GUI back to you. Move things around. Make them bigger. Make them smaller. Tuck that one widget you never use into the corner of oblivion. Build a HUD layout that actually makes sense for how you play.  

### ✨ What Can You Do With It?  

🖱️ Drag & Reposition — Grab any HUD element and drop it exactly where you want it. No more fighting over screen space.  
🔲 Resize to Your Heart's Content — Scale elements up for visibility or shrink them down to reclaim precious screen real estate. Your HUD, your scale.  
🧹 Tame the Clutter — Heavily modded instance? No problem. MenuMolder is built specifically for those of us who have a few too many mods installed. (We don't judge.)  
⚡ Lightweight by Design — All this power without weighing down your game. MenuMolder stays out of the way so you can stay in the action.  
🤝 Non-Destructive — Your mods are untouched. MenuMolder simply rearranges the furniture — it doesn't throw anything out.  


### 🛠️ Who Is This For?  
If you've ever:  

Installed more than 10 mods and lost your health bar somewhere beneath a minimap...  
Wanted a HUD element to just be a little bit bigger...  
Spent five minutes trying to find a specific widget buried under three others...  

...then MenuMolder was made for you.
